newsitem.title: SPAIN: Continente 9-mth net profit 6.47 bln ptas.
newsitem.headline: Continente 9-mth net profit 6.47 bln ptas.

text.p: Group results for Spanish hypermarket Continente for the nine months to end-September in billions of pesetas, unless stated:

NOTE: The firm said pretax profit of 8.92 billion pesetas was not comparable to the 9.05 billion pesetas posted in the year-earlier period, as the 1995 figure included a 1 billion peseta capital gain.

The company plans to re-open under the Continente name the Hipermas hypermarkets in Andujar and Alcazar de San Juan, bringing the total number of stores to 48, up six versus the end of the previous financial year.
The firm provided no further information.
